content.short: Transit Swap is a multichain trading app that aggregates token swaps, bridge routes, and DEX liquidity across supported networks.
content.description: Transit Swap is a cross-chain trading product from Transit Finance that brings token swaps, bridging, and route comparison into one interface. The platform aggregates liquidity from decentralized exchanges across multiple supported networks and shows users different paths for executing trades or moving assets between chains. TON appears here as one of the supported ecosystems, making Transit Swap more of a multichain routing layer than a TON native exchange or wallet, especially for users comparing price execution across ecosystems.
content.meta: Transit Swap aggregates cross-chain swaps, bridge routes, and DEX liquidity.
